title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten recurring Loyola University Maryland traditions documented by the university, spanning campus culture, scholarship, service, music, faith, and athletics.

cards.title: Begin the spring term with the MLK Convocation
cards.subtitle: Annual January community convocation
cards.notes: Look for the annual January program and use it as a focused way to join Loyola’s public inquiry into race, justice, politics, and spirituality.
cards.short_summary: A Loyola-wide January gathering centered on issues of racial justice and public life.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes MLK Convocation as an annual January gathering for shared inquiry into social justice, politics, spirituality, and the legacies of race and racial justice in America.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Check Loyola’s event listings for the current year’s program details.

cards.title: Wear green and grey for the Battle of Charles Street
cards.subtitle: Annual Loyola–Johns Hopkins lacrosse matchup
cards.notes: Follow the scheduled lacrosse matchup with Johns Hopkins and experience the rivalry in the stands alongside the Greyhound community.
cards.short_summary: The annual lacrosse meeting between Loyola and nearby rival Johns Hopkins.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies the Battle of Charles Street as its annual lacrosse matchup against long-time local rival Johns Hopkins University.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Loyola Athletics schedule and ticket information before attending.

cards.title: Catch the campus-scale energy of Loyolapalooza
cards.subtitle: Annual spring festival and concert
cards.notes: Watch for spring announcements, then plan around the concert and festival programming; the Battle of the Bands winner opens the show.
cards.short_summary: A spring festival that combines rides, food, activities, and a headline concert on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says its annual springtime Loyolapalooza brings carnival rides, food, fun, and a concert to campus, opened by the Battle of the Bands winner.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Programming and attendance details vary by year; check Student Leadership and Involvement announcements.

cards.title: See the BSA Fashion Show take the stage
cards.subtitle: Black Student Association cultural showcase
cards.notes: Look for the Black Student Association’s event details and attend the show to support a campus celebration of Black culture and talent.
cards.short_summary: A fashion, music, and community event organized by Loyola’s Black Student Association.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes the BSA Fashion Show as a highly anticipated Black Student Association event celebrating Black culture and talent through fashion, music, and community.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Check the Black Student Association or campus events calendar for current presentation details.

cards.title: Mark graduation season at Senior Soiree
cards.subtitle: Senior-class celebration before Commencement
cards.notes: Eligible seniors can watch for class communications and use the evening to celebrate together before the Commencement ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A formal senior-class gathering with dinner, dancing, and a pre-Commencement sendoff.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Senior Soiree as a senior-class gathering under a tent on the President’s Lawn for dinner, dancing, and celebration before Commencement.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: This event is for the graduating senior class; consult senior-class communications for participation details.

cards.title: Open the year at the Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Early-September gathering in Alumni Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: In early September, join the Loyola community in Alumni Memorial Chapel for music, song, and prayer for the academic year ahead.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s opening-of-year Mass, connected to a Jesuit educational tradition dating to 1548.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says the community gathers at the Mass of the Holy Spirit early each September and traces the tradition to the first Jesuit school in Messina, Sicily, in 1548.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Held early in September; verify the current academic-year date and chapel details through Loyola events.

cards.title: Reconnect during Initium Week
cards.subtitle: Annual fall return-to-campus week
cards.notes: Use the fall schedule to pick a concert, game, tournament, or the Student Activities Fair as a low-pressure way to reconnect on campus.
cards.short_summary: A fall week of events welcoming students back to campus and community.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes Initium Week as a fall return-to-campus week with events to reconnect, including concerts, games, a beach volleyball tournament, and the Fall Student Activities Fair.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Review the current Initium Week calendar and select individual events that fit your schedule.

cards.title: Hear the Belles and Chimes at Chordbusters
cards.subtitle: Twice-yearly a cappella concert
cards.notes: Plan ahead when ticket information is released for this twice-yearly concert featuring Loyola’s Belles and Chimes a cappella groups.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Loyola a cappella showcase with the Belles and Chimes.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Chordbusters as a twice-a-year a cappella concert and reports that the Belles and Chimes have performed it together since 1986.
cards.access_notes: Ticket availability can be limited; use the current event announcement for timing and access information.

cards.title: Follow a text through the Humanities Symposium
cards.subtitle: Week-long liberal-arts event series
cards.notes: Check the featured text and event lineup, then choose a session that connects students, faculty, friends of Loyola, and Baltimore participants.
cards.short_summary: A week-long series of events centered on a selected text and Loyola’s liberal-arts heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes the Humanities Symposium as a week-long series of events related to a particular text for students, faculty, friends of the University, and the Baltimore community.
cards.source_title: School Spirit and Traditions | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: The featured text and individual sessions change by year; consult the current symposium schedule.

cards.title: Share candlelight and song at Lessons & Carols
cards.subtitle: Seasonal service in Alumni Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: Arrive with enough time for a chapel service that combines candlelight and Christmas carols during Loyola’s Advent and Christmas season.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Loyola chapel service of candlelight, carols, and scripture.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Lessons & Carols as a seasonal service in Alumni Memorial Chapel featuring candlelight and Christmas carols; Loyola Magazine reports the tradition has brought campus together since 1988.
cards.access_notes: Verify the current seasonal date and chapel entry details through Loyola’s events calendar.
